notes.title: Wild West Supermarket Simulator is out now!
notes.content:
Howdy shopkeepers!

We hope you are as ready as we are for your journey in the Wild West! After a successful demo run during Steam Next Fest in June, we collected a lot of valuable feedback from you, the Community. We used the time to tweak, enhance and improve every level of the game, so it's ready to start into it's Early Access phase in the best way possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

[h3]Wild West Supermarket Simulator is available now![/h3]

Open your very own Wild West Store, try to balance the sheets and ideally bring in a hefty profit, and react to random events that affect the supply and demand of your customer's needs. Also, if you want a more challenging approach than the "Standard" mode, just use "realistic prices" and live from every penny you get.

While playing, you can level up your store, expand the premises and gain access to new products through various minigames. Of course, you can also decorate your shop, as well as your homestead, while overlooking the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/5e0987b57a091fc7b41b64ffcc0d7e053ecce2c7.png[/img]

[h3]And, what's next to come?[/h3]

The next things we will focus on, are improving the game and [b]fix any bugs[/b] that may come up, as well as add [b]achievements[/b] and [b]controller support[/b].

We've also planned to add more [b]types of customers[/b], [b]new challenges for minigames[/b] and [b]extend the shelf management[/b].

And, Wild West Supermarket Simulator will get [b]more workers[/b] to hire, an [b]improved order book[/b] and [b]shelves for the storage room[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

[h3]Send us your feedback![/h3]

For Wild West Supermarket Simulator, we are very happy to receive a lot of feedback from you! And in order to sort stuff on our end in a better way, we created a Feature Upvote board, where you can simply add your feedback in a quick way - and upvote other's.

You don't have to create an account, enter your real email address (or one at all) or put in your real name. Just provide us with feedback. We will listen to your ideas and suggestions as much as possible in the future.

https://wwgss.featureupvote.com

We're looking forward to enjoying this journey with you together - and now we wish you much fun with your own store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630532/408a6b20c289eec8a159a45a51d16d4435d258d0.png[/img]

notes.title: We're bringing the Band(s) back together
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316778/ba9977e1edd1d92a3a009efc810a0e00d9c6ea1e.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow chaos musicians,

we are happy to announce that we just dropped a new update for Disaster Band. The extensive list of changes and additions you can find a little further down below.

Furthermore, we are thrilled to announce that very soon you'll find even more players to join you on your journey to dominate the global stage.

On July 11, Disaster Band will be released on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch - with full cross-platform multiplayer on all systems and support for additional songs via Mod.io on PlayStation and Xbox.

We are very much looking forward to welcoming console players to the Disaster Band family!

Produktivkeller Studio and SunDust

[hr][/hr]

[h3][u][b]Ver.: 1.16.1.41[/b][/u][/h3]

[u][b]General Improvements[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Instruments will not continue to play if the button is held at the end of a song.
[*] It is now possible to pause a song in Single Player.
[*] Do not evaluate user input when interaction is blocked in 'Music Arena'. Instead use the perfect pitch so it is less bad for other players in the multiplayer session.[/list]

[u][b]Steam Invites / Friend list features[/b][/u]
[list][*] Players can invite their friends to join a session. Invites can be accepted from anywhere in the game.
[*] Players can now join friends using the Steam Overlay.[/list]

[u][b]MOD.IO[/b][/u]

[list][*] We now officially support mod.io in the game. You can download and browse mods using the mod.io browser. All songs that are currently on Steam Workshop will stay in the game and continue to be fully playable. But they are not available in cross-platform-multiplayer.[/list]

[u][b]New Controller Input Modes[/b][/u]

[list][*] Auto-Tune Hero  -> Player just have to hit the timing of the note, the pitch is always perfect
[*] Guided Chaos   -> Players have to move the stick in the direction of the next note before playing it
[*] Freestyle Fiasco  -> Hands on direct input mapping of the movement of the stick

[*] For each controller mode there is now a distinct leaderboard!
[*] Players are asked to select their preferred controller assistance type after the Start Screen (to change this players can always go back to the start screen).[/list]

[u][b]Improvement of the previous Controller Support:[/b][/u]

[list][*] There is now an option to enable controller vibration in the general settings.
[*] We now also support PS5 controllers.
[*] Appropriate controller icons are being used everywhere.
[*] When the back button is pressed in the lobby, the pause menu now opens.
[*] Leaderboard tables can now be scrolled conveniently with a controller.
[*] Display controls footer after closing the "Delete a save game dialog".[/list]

[u][b]User Interface Improvements[/b][/u]

[list][*] Set the font size for the player name in the result screen to '22'. This ensures that player names with 16 characters like 'WMWMWMWMWMWMWMWM' can be displayed.
[*] Auto size lobby badge for extra long user names.
[*] No longer display "No Games Found" right away when opening the session table, only show it if there are actually no games found after one second.
[*] Host would not start with 100% accuracy.
[*] Expandable menu in lobby on the right side would add 'host' suffix to player name when playing in single player.
[*] Show feedback notification after multiplayer shutdown or disconnect after kick.
[*] Increase the width of the player name in the menu so the full name can be displayed.
[*] Add an options menu with kick and report option to the band tab in the lobby for each connected player.
[*] Use the existing scroll view handling for settings entry scrolling.
[*] Scroll the settings menu to the top when initializing so the selected element is visible.
[*] Always select the first button when the menu is opened.
[*] Update lobby badge for newer instruments.
[*] Increase length for normal splash screen as VFX effect got cut off.[/list]


[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list][*] When a client has already returned to the lobby while the host selects 'Return to lobby' in the pause menu while being in the music arena, the client would show an infinite loading screen as the scene to unload is not valid.
[*] Disconnect voice-line was audible when the local player got kicked.
[*] Region badge in lobby now shows "automatic" instead of broken translation key if the automatic region is unknown because it has recently been added to Fusion.[/list]





[url=https://discord.gg/toplitz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316778/98ba222c713c3d50dd0c715bd3fcd6ff0f20d78f.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update to version 1.12
notes.content:
Hello fellow Disaster Bandmates!

The good things keep on coming.
In this case a new content patch that not only gives you more choice in terms of songs and instruments, e.g., now you can play the traditional Chinese instrument Erhu, but also some technical improvements.

[previewyoutube=0l4nwhmlPic;full][/previewyoutube]

But we don’t want to keep you longer than necessary from taking center stage so here are the changes and additions:

[FEATURE] Background tracks can now be either .mp3 files or .wav files, to allow for smaller song directories. Also, the .wav files of all the base tracks have been replaced with .mp3 files.
[FEATURE] A new hint after the start screen has been added that shows the user Steam workshop songs that he has not subscribed to. This can be adjusted and also disabled in the settings.
[FEATURE] A button to download the missing song will be shown to the user when the host selects a Steam workshop song that is missing. The game no longer has to be restarted.
[FEATURE] The animation for the Theremin is now more satisfying. There now is more visual feedback for pressing the play button.
[FEATURE] A new animation for the Choir has been added.
[FEATURE] A new traditional Chinese instrument, the Erhu, has been added, including a custom animation.
[FEATURE] A new instrument has been added: The Cat. Miaow!
[FEATURE] A new song 'Frère Jacques' has been added.

Enjoy while we prepare the next content serving coming to your screen very soon!

The teams from

Produktivkeller Studios and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Disaster Band: Update with choir and new track
notes.content:
Hello chaos musicians,

we proudly give you a new update for Disaster Band.

Next to a few optimizations like improved instrument sounds we present a new song (the title track "Derp Derp") and a new instrument, the choir, which is a perfect addition to any band configuration.

Here are all the fixes, optimizations, and additions:

[h3]Feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] Instrument improvement: Adjusted loudness, added reverb and new samples for several instruments.
[*] Instrument improvement: Glissandi can now be played across the entire two octave range.
[*] Instrument improvement: Introduced a new system for pitching between notes.
[*] Added new song: Derp Derp.
[*] Added new custom cursor in treble clef shape.
[*] Added new instrument Choir.
[*] Set default volume of all adjustable channels to 80%.
[*] Automatically selecting last used instrument and song.
[*] Making instrument selection scalable and added a badge for new instruments.
[*] BPM can now also be declared as a floating point number in metadata.json.
[*] Set volume for other players to 80% and volume of self to 90%, by default.
[/list]

[h3] FIXED [/h3]
[list]
[*] Making sure to always start a new note when hitting the play button fast multiple times in a row.
[*] Clean-up tones after the track ends.
[*] Resolved multiple errors that were logged when exiting the music arena.
[/list]

Finally, we have a small outlook on the next content update which can be expected within the next few days: 

You can look forward to further instruments (e.g., electric guitar), which of course you can use in the new tracks like the "Ride of the Valkyries".
